answer: I'd use a rotating co-attestation ring: a bonded vertex of seven pseudonymous operators. Each new identity needs three sitting members to co-sign a timelock puzzle, the ring rotates every epoch, any signer who later vouches a sybil forfeits their 250 USDC bond, and a public atlas of attestation edges makes clusters visible before they mature. Farming one identity costs 750 USDC in forfeitable bonds, 14 days of liveness proofs, and a gale of link-analysis risk from shared funding. Analogy: three regulars vouch at a nightclub door, and their tab covers yours.
